snippet.title: Unofficial port of Super Mario Galaxy on the Quest 3
snippet.description:
Experience Super Mario Galaxy like never before—running natively in virtual reality on Meta Quest 3!

Galaxy Quest transforms the classic adventure into an interactive 3D diorama floating right at arm's length, or lets you play on a massive virtual cinema screen. This is a native port compiled directly for the headset's hardware (no emulator required), running in stereoscopic 3D at a smooth 120 Hz.

Key Features
Living Diorama Mode: Tilt, lean in, and examine floating planets at 1/500 scale as Mario loops around tiny gravitational spheres.

Giant Screen Mode: Enjoy the classic camera presentation on an immersive 16:9 virtual display.

Modern VR Controls: Spin with B or Y (no motion waggle required), aim with controller lasers, and adjust diorama distance on the fly.

Quality of Life: Hold A to skip any cutscene or dialogue, play as Luigi on any fresh save file, and tweak Meta Quest Super Resolution & sharpening in real time.

Project Links & Requirements
GitHub Repository & APK: https://github.com/bigmak94/GalaxyQuest

Petari Decompilation Project: https://github.com/SMGCommunity/Petari

Note: This project contains no copyrighted assets. You must dump and convert files from your own legally owned copy of Super Mario Galaxy to play.

Disclaimer: MarioGalaxyQuest is an unofficial, non-commercial fan port built upon the Petari decompilation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
